class.name: ResourceManager
class.brief_description: Manages synchronous and asynchronous resource loading.
class.description:
ResourceManager wraps Godot's [ResourceLoader] to provide [ResourceHandle]-based loading. Async loading uses [code]load_threaded_request[/code] + per-frame polling via [code]SceneTree.process_frame[/code]. On platforms without threads (single-threaded Web export), it falls back to synchronous load.
Owned by [Application] — not a global singleton.

method.name: get_handle
method.description: Returns a [ResourceHandle] for [param path], creating one if it doesn't exist. The handle tracks loading state; use it to check progress or connect to signals.

method.name: load_async
method.description: Loads the resource at [param path] asynchronously. [param callback] receives the loaded [Resource] (or [code]null[/code] on failure). [param priority] is currently ignored (reserved for future use).

method.name: load_sync
method.description: Synchronously loads the resource at [param path] and returns it immediately.
